source.title: Stara Lesna Meadows
source.author: Lubomir Hambalek
source.credit: Stara Lesna Meadows — Lubomir Hambalek; resized and alpha encoded by Starward

processing: Starward resampled the full transparent panorama to 1024×512 and 2048×1024 using a source canvas; exact PNG alpha is published as lossless row RLE. Runtime exposure follows the selected Sun altitude; red mode uses a display luminance transform. No site registration or imported observer state.
limitations: Generic simulated scenery: these Slovak mountains and meadows are not the selected observing location or measured obstruction. The raw image seam is assigned virtual ENU north; the author’s true-north registration is not established.
Historical photograph with fixed captured illumination; display exposure is illustrative, not current weather, measured atmospheric transparency or physically reconstructed local lighting.

Package readme states CC BY 4.0, while the landscape registry states CC BY-SA 4.0. Both notices are retained; Starward distributes these image derivatives under the more restrictive CC BY-SA 4.0. This asset license does not license the independently written renderer.
